_note: The standard deduction in any regime other than the new one: the statutory amount or the salary, whichever is less (D-093; rulebook SAL-STDDED-002, -003). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(1) Table Sl. 2(b) (p.41): "₹ 50000 or the salary, whichever is less, in any other case". Finance Act, 2026 (4 of 2026) searched in full: it does not amend s.19 or s.202. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.16(ia) (thc.nic.in p.140): "a deduction of fifty thousand rupees or the amount of the salary, whichever is less", "fifty thousand" substituted for "forty thousand" by Finance Act, 2019 (7 of 2019) s.3, w.e.f. 1-4-2020 (read in the Act's text, p.1 "[21st February, 2019.]"). Not searched: amendments to s.16(ia) other than Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 s.10's proviso, which applies only in the new regime. CBDT ITR-1 Validation Rules for AY 2026-27 rule 112 (p.10) applies Rs 50000 in the old regime.
